_comment: Radio environment for the Metro ride. Each network has one or more cells (positions in metres along the route). Signal in dBm is ref_dbm_1m - 10 * exponent * log10(distance), with distance never below min_distance_m, plus a small deterministic fade that depends only on position, so two runs of the same ride see the same signal. Dead zones subtract extra_loss_db from every network (a tunnel shields all of them). Below usable_dbm the core router drops everything to and from the mobile node on that link. The model is ours, it is not taken from a standard.
